memory_candidates.content: In this repo's extension deploy system, the absolute path to the source store on the deploying machine is already stamped at deploy time into <project-root>/.claude-extensions.json under extensions.<name>.source_dir (plus source_git_head), for every loaded extension. This file lives outside .claude/ specifically so it survives a .claude wipe, and is already treated as authoritative-with-known-degraded-case by check-deploy-freshness.sh. Any rule or doc that needs to point an agent at the source-store location from inside a deployed tree should resolve it via this field rather than hard-coding a path, since the field is machine-local, always kept fresh by redeploys, and requires no new deploy-machinery to consume.
